```python
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Job data
jobs = {
    0: {"processing_time": 11, "due_date": 320, "weight": 3},
    1: {"processing_time": 42, "due_date": 274, "weight": 4},
    2: {"processing_time": 26, "due_date": 108, "weight": 5},
    3: {"processing_time": 55, "due_date": 308, "weight": 5},
    4: {"processing_time": 36, "due_date": 93, "weight": 9},
    5: {"processing_time": 34, "due_date": 66, "weight": 3},
    6: {"processing_time": 75, "due_date": 198, "weight": 5},
    7: {"processing_time": 65, "due_date": 199, "weight": 5},
    8: {"processing_time": 61, "due_date": 112, "weight": 8},
    9: {"processing_time": 53, "due_date": 113, "weight": 2},
}

# Create a new model
model = gp.Model("single_machine_scheduling")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Create variables
n = len(jobs)
x = model.addVars(n, n, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")
C = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="C")
T = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="T")

# Set objective
model.setObjective(gp.quicksum(jobs[j]["weight"] * T[j] for j in range(n)), GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Add constraints
model.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for j in range(n)) == 1 for i in range(n)), name="assign_once")
model.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[j, i] for j in range(n)) == 1 for i in range(n)), name="assigned_once")

model.addConstrs(
    (C[j] >= jobs[j]["processing_time"] + gp.quicksum(jobs[i]["processing_time"] * x[i, j] for i in range(n)) - 
     gp.quicksum(jobs[i]["processing_time"] * x[i, j-1] for i in range(n)) for j in range(1, n)), name="completion_time"
)

model.addConstrs((C[j] >= jobs[j]["processing_time"] for j in range(n)), name="completion_time_first")

model.addConstrs((T[j] >= C[j] - jobs[j]["due_date"] for j in range(n)), name="tardiness")

# Optimize model
model.optimize()

# Extract the sequence
sequence = [j for j in range(n) for i in range(n) if x[i, j].X > 0.5]

# Calculate the objective value
objective_value = model.ObjVal

# Print the result
import json
print(json.dumps({"sequence": sequence, "objective_value": objective_value}))
```
